body:
KubeClipper manages the Kubernetes cluster lifecycle, including creation, scaling, upgrades, backup, recovery, and deletion, through a web console, API, and the kcctl CLI.
Architecture in 1.7 kc-server serves the API and persists clusters, Operations, and Tasks. Controllers advance their state. kc-agent runs on managed nodes. It accesses the Server API over mTLS, watches assigned tasks, executes them, and reports results. kcctl / Console submit management requests and display platform health, progress, and logs. etcd stores platform resources and state. Plan platform etcd separately from the etcd clusters used by managed Kubernetes clusters. 1.7 uses API-driven Operation v2 rather than built-in NATS task delivery. Operations run asynchronously. Confirm results using Operations, cluster state, and the actual nodes. See operations and logs.
Networking Purpose Default port Clients Console TCP 80 Browsers; configure HTTPS at the production entry point Server API TCP 8080, HTTPS kcctl, Console, Agents Resource file service TCP 8081 Nodes downloading resources Platform etcd TCP 12379 / 12380 / 12381 client / peer / metrics; restrict to the management network Agent task logs TCP 10260 Server to Agent; restrict access for the actual configuration SSH TCP 22 Deployment and node maintenance Deployment configuration can change these ports. Check Agent task-log listener configuration against firewall rules as well; older NATS port lists do not apply.
--ip-detect selects the platform management address. --node-ip-detect selects the Kubernetes node address. Check connectivity explicitly on hosts with multiple interfaces. Pod network address detection belongs to the selected CNI configuration.

This guide deploys a highly available KubeClipper control plane. Platform availability and the availability of managed Kubernetes clusters require separate planning.
Prepare nodes and networking Prepare three Linux Server nodes and the Agent nodes you want to manage. The deployment user needs SSH access to every node with the same private key and sudo privileges. See architecture and networking for clock synchronization and ports.
Platform etcd runs on Server nodes. Plan membership and failure tolerance around etcd quorum requirements. Keep platform Servers separate from Kubernetes workload nodes in production.
Install and download Follow Getting started to install v1.7.0 kcctl and download the complete kc-amd64.tar.gz or kc-arm64.tar.gz package for your targets. GitHub Release client archives are not deployment packages for --pkg.
Deploy Servers and Agents Replace the IP addresses, private key, and package path. --server accepts comma-separated addresses; --agent can include a region.
read -r -s -p 'Set the admin password: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy \ --server 192.168.10.11,192.168.10.12,192.168.10.13 \ --agent default:192.168.10.21,192.168.10.22 \ --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-amd64.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD Keep TLS enabled. On hosts with multiple interfaces, select reachable addresses using --ip-detect and --node-ip-detect; consult kcctl deploy -h. Platform etcd ports default to 12379, 12380, and 12381.
Verify the platform kcctl login --host https://192.168.10.11:8080 --username admin kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl get node Check services on all three Servers, platform etcd membership, and Agent health. Repeat API connectivity checks against the other Servers. Configure a load balancer and certificates separately if you need a common hostname or VIP; deploying three Servers does not provision an entry-point VIP.
Browsers use each Server’s default HTTP port 80 console entry point; the CLI uses the HTTPS port 8080 API. Configure HTTPS at the production console entry point and restrict management ports to the intended networks.
Add and remove Agents kcctl join --agent default:192.168.10.23 kcctl get node After confirming the node has no clusters or workloads to retain, remove it:
kcctl drain --agent 192.168.10.23 Investigate a normal drain failure before choosing further actions. Do not use force options by default. See the upgrade checklist before changing versions.

本文部署 KubeClipper 平台的高可用控制面。平台 Server 的高可用与受管 Kubernetes 集群的高可用是两件事，需分别规划。
准备节点与网络 准备三个 Linux Server 节点，以及需要纳管的 Agent 节点。部署用户通过同一 SSH 私钥访问所有节点，并具备 sudo 权限。时间同步和端口要求见架构与网络。
Server 节点部署平台 etcd，节点数量和故障容忍按 etcd 仲裁要求规划。生产环境建议将平台 Server 与运行 Kubernetes 工作负载的节点分开。
安装和下载 按照快速开始安装 v1.7.0 kcctl，下载与目标架构匹配的完整 kc-amd64.tar.gz 或 kc-arm64.tar.gz 部署包。不要将 GitHub Release 的客户端二进制包传给 --pkg。
部署三个 Server 和 Agent 将示例 IP、私钥和部署包路径替换为实际值。--server 使用逗号分隔地址，--agent 可按区域填写。
read -r -s -p '设置 admin 密码: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy \ --server 192.168.10.11,192.168.10.12,192.168.10.13 \ --agent default:192.168.10.21,192.168.10.22 \ --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-amd64.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD 保持 TLS 开启。多网卡环境通过 --ip-detect 与 --node-ip-detect 显式选择可达地址；可使用 kcctl deploy -h 核对参数。默认平台 etcd 端口为 12379、12380、12381。
验证结果 kcctl login --host https://192.168.10.11:8080 --username admin kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl get node 检查三个 Server 的服务状态、平台 etcd 成员和 Agent 是否正常。在其他 Server 地址重复检查 API 可达性。需要统一域名或 VIP 时，另行配置入口负载均衡和证书；部署三个 Server 不会自动创建入口 VIP。
浏览器默认访问各 Server 的 HTTP 80 控制台入口；CLI 使用 HTTPS 8080 API。生产入口应配置 HTTPS，并按实际网络限制管理端口访问。
添加和移除 Agent kcctl join --agent default:192.168.10.23 kcctl get node 确认节点没有需要保留的集群和工作负载后，再执行移除：
kcctl drain --agent 192.168.10.23 先查看正常 drain 的错误原因，再决定后续处理；不要默认使用强制参数。升级前参见升级检查。

body:
This guide uses KubeClipper v1.7.0. Deploy the platform on an SSH-accessible Linux host with systemd, then create a single-node test cluster. See high availability for production topology.
Prepare the host Install curl, tar, and sudo. Enable SSH and give the deployment user sudo privileges. Run chrony, ntp, or systemd-timesyncd to keep clocks synchronized. Prepare an SSH private key that can log in to the target host and check network connectivity. Check the kernel, cgroup, and runtime requirements of the Kubernetes version you select. Operating system lists from older guides do not establish compatibility with newer Kubernetes versions. Allow disk space for downloading and extracting packages and loading container images. The complete 1.7.0 deployment package is about 1.2 GiB. The roughly 60 MB binary archives on GitHub Release do not replace it. Install kcctl Download the installer from the 1.7.0 release tag before running it. It downloads binaries from the project’s native Alibaba Cloud OSS endpoint rather than the old oss.kubeclipper.io domain.
curl -fL -o get-kubeclipper.sh \ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubeclipper/kubeclipper/v1.7.0/scripts/get-kubeclipper.sh KC_VERSION=v1.7.0 bash get-kubeclipper.sh kcctl version The client supports Linux and macOS on amd64 and arm64. Platform services run on Linux; run the following deployment commands on a Linux deployment host. Clients are also available from the v1.7.0 Release.
Download the complete deployment package Set ARCH to the target architecture. Use arm64 instead of amd64 for ARM hosts.
ARCH=amd64 curl -fL -o "kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" \ "https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/release/v1.7.0/kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" tar -tzf "kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" | head The complete package includes platform services, the console, and offline resources. Download it on a connected host and transfer it to the deployment host for an air-gapped installation. Before creating a cluster, check that resource versions and architectures are present; see offline clusters.
Deploy All-in-One Replace the private key path below. SSH access to the target is required even when the target is the deployment host itself.
read -r -s -p 'Set the admin password: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD The initial password must be 8–16 characters and include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits. If prechecks fail, resolve the reported node and check before retrying.
Agents in 1.7 access the Server API over mTLS. Keep TLS enabled during deployment. The default console endpoint is http://SERVER_IP:80; the Server API is https://SERVER_IP:8080. They serve different purposes.
Log in and check the platform Replace SERVER_IP with your Server address. Login prompts for the admin password you set above.
SERVER_IP=192.168.10.10 kcctl login --host "https://${SERVER_IP}:8080" --username admin kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl get node kcctl resource list Open http://SERVER_IP for the console. Configure HTTPS at the console entry point in production. status reports platform health and doctor provides diagnostic evidence; neither repairs the environment.
Create a cluster Choose a Ready node from kcctl get node and set NODE to its ID or IP. Offline installation is the default; first confirm that matching resource packages are available.
NODE=192.168.10.10 kcctl create cluster --name demo --master "$NODE" --untaint-master \ --k8s-version v1.37.0 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml --untaint-master lets this test cluster schedule regular workloads on the control-plane node. Installation time depends on hardware, connectivity, and image availability. Successful submission is followed by an asynchronous Operation; inspect its result and the cluster state.
Obtain the cluster kubeconfig from the console, set KUBECONFIG, then check Kubernetes:
kubectl get nodes -o wide kubectl get pods -A kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose' Confirm Running cluster state, Ready nodes, system Pod health, and API readiness. See operations and logs and platform diagnostics when a task fails.
Remove the test cluster This deletes the demo cluster. Confirm that no workloads or data must be retained before running it:
kcctl delete cluster demo kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster Wait for deletion to finish and confirm the cluster is gone. Investigate failures before considering state resets or forced deletion.

body:
Platform upgrades and managed Kubernetes upgrades are separate procedures. This page covers platform checks; it does not promise a direct upgrade from every older release to 1.7.
Before upgrading Record Server, Agent, kcctl, and Console versions and node topology. Confirm package architecture. Review release notes, security advisories, and configuration changes. 1.7 introduces Operation v2; inspect old operation records and task state in a test environment. Choose a window with no running installation, upgrade, or backup operations. Resolve unfinished work first. Back up platform etcd, Server and Agent configuration, certificates, and persistent authentication keys. Verify recovery. Back up managed-cluster data separately. Rehearse the target upgrade path in a recoverable test environment and record interruption and recovery steps. kcctl version kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl operation list kcctl upgrade -h Upgrade kcctl upgrade supports platform and component upgrades. Use a package with the structure described in command help that you have validated in a test environment. Client archives are not platform upgrade packages.
UPGRADE_PACKAGE=/path/to/validated-upgrade-package.tar.gz kcctl upgrade all --pkg "$UPGRADE_PACKAGE" Use online upgrades or individual component replacement only when the release or your validated deployment procedure supports them. Replacing one binary does not establish that the whole platform upgrade succeeded.
After upgrading Repeat kcctl status and kcctl doctor and verify versions running on every node. Check login, node data, operation details and logs, managed-cluster access, and basic Console flows. Exercise a controlled lifecycle operation and compare the Operation result with actual cluster state.
Preserve errors and logs on failure and follow the recovery procedure tested beforehand. Check data and configuration compatibility before restoring old binaries; do not repeatedly overwrite services in an unknown state.

curl -fL -o get-kubeclipper.sh \ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubeclipper/kubeclipper/v1.7.0/scripts/get-kubeclipper.sh KC_VERSION=v1.7.0 bash get-kubeclipper.sh kcctl version 脚本支持 Linux、macOS 的 amd64 和 arm64 客户端。平台服务部署在 Linux 上；以下命令在 Linux 部署机运行。也可以从 v1.7.0 Release 下载对应客户端。
下载完整部署包 按目标平台架构设置 ARCH。下例为 amd64；arm64 主机将其改为 arm64。
ARCH=amd64 curl -fL -o "kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" \ "https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/release/v1.7.0/kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" tar -tzf "kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" | head 完整部署包包含平台服务、控制台及离线资源。离线环境需要提前在联网机器下载，再传入部署机。创建 Kubernetes 集群时还应核对平台中已有的组件包和架构，见离线创建集群。
部署 All-in-One 平台 以下示例使用 SSH 私钥。替换为自己的私钥路径；部署机必须能够通过 SSH 登录目标节点，即使目标节点就是本机。
read -r -s -p '设置 admin 密码: ' KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD printf '\n' kcctl deploy --user root --pk-file "$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa" \ --pkg "$PWD/kc-${ARCH}.tar.gz" \ --initial-password "$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" unset KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD 初始密码需满足平台校验要求：8–16 位，包含大写字母、小写字母和数字。部署前检查失败时，先处理输出中对应的节点和检查项，不要反复重装。
1.7 的 Agent 通过 mTLS 访问 Server API，部署时保持 TLS 开启。默认控制台为 http://SERVER_IP:80，Server API 为 https://SERVER_IP:8080，这两个入口用途不同。
登录并检查平台 将 SERVER_IP 替换为实际 Server 地址。命令会提示输入刚才设置的 admin 密码。
SERVER_IP=192.168.10.10 kcctl login --host "https://${SERVER_IP}:8080" --username admin kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl get node kcctl resource list 通过浏览器访问 http://SERVER_IP 可打开控制台。生产环境应在控制台入口配置 HTTPS。status 检查平台状态，doctor 给出诊断证据；它们不会自动修复环境。
创建第一个集群 从 kcctl get node 的结果选择就绪节点，将节点 ID 或 IP 填入 NODE。离线方式是默认值；先确认已有对应架构和版本的资源包。
NODE=192.168.10.10 kcctl create cluster --name demo --master "$NODE" --untaint-master \ --k8s-version v1.37.0 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml --untaint-master 允许实验集群在控制节点调度普通工作负载。安装耗时取决于机器、网络和镜像准备情况。命令提交成功后，继续查看 Operation 和集群状态，不能把提交成功当作安装完成。
从集群详情页获取 kubeconfig，设置 KUBECONFIG 后检查 Kubernetes：
kubectl get nodes -o wide kubectl get pods -A kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose' 确认集群处于 Running、节点 Ready，并检查系统 Pod 和 API 健康状况。任务失败时参考操作与日志和平台诊断。
清理实验集群 以下操作会删除 demo 集群，先确认其中没有需要保留的工作负载和数据：
kcctl delete cluster demo kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster 等待删除操作结束并确认集群已移除。不要使用重置状态或强制删除来代替失败原因排查。

平台升级与受管 Kubernetes 集群升级分别处理。本文介绍 KubeClipper 平台升级前后的检查，不承诺任意旧版本都可直接升级到 1.7。
升级前 记录 Server、Agent、kcctl 和 Console 的版本及节点拓扑，确认目标包的 CPU 架构。 查看目标版本的 Release、安全公告和配置变化。1.7 改用 Operation v2，旧操作记录和任务状态需要在测试环境核对。 在没有运行中安装、升级、备份等操作的窗口执行。先处理未完成或失败的操作。 备份平台 etcd、Server/Agent 配置、证书与持久化认证密钥，并验证恢复方法。受管集群的数据备份需要单独安排。 在可恢复的测试环境演练目标升级路径，记录服务中断和恢复步骤。 kcctl version kcctl status kcctl doctor kcctl operation list kcctl upgrade -h 执行升级 kcctl upgrade 支持整个平台或组件升级。目标包应满足命令帮助中的目录结构，并已经在测试环境验证；不要把客户端包当成平台升级包。
UPGRADE_PACKAGE=/path/to/validated-upgrade-package.tar.gz kcctl upgrade all --pkg "$UPGRADE_PACKAGE" 只有 Release 或已验证部署流程明确支持时，才使用在线升级或组件独立替换。不要把替换一个二进制文件视为整个升级完成。
升级后 再次检查 kcctl status、kcctl doctor，核对各节点实际运行版本。验证登录、节点信息、操作详情与日志、受管集群访问及 Console 基本流程。测试一个受控的生命周期操作，确认 Operation 和实际集群状态一致。
升级失败时保留错误和日志，按事先验证的恢复步骤处理。恢复旧二进制前先判断数据和配置是否仍兼容，不要在未知状态下反复覆盖服务。

Kubeadm cluster hosting For a host cluster created and managed by kubeadm, kubeclipper gets the cluster and node information from the kubeconfig file and imports it into the kubeclipper platform.
Click “Cluster Management” > “Cluster Hosting” button to enter the cluster hosting page. Click “Add” button at the upper left corner. In the pop-up window of Add Provider, fill in the provider name (such as kubeadm-demo) and description, and then fill in the following information:
Region: The region of the cluster and node in the kubeclipper platform.
Provider type: Select kubeadm.
SSH: Specifies the connection method of cluster nodes. Private Key or Password can be selected. Ensure that all cluster nodes can be connected through the selected method.
Private Key: enter the node user name and private key information. Password: enter the node user name and password. Cluster name: Specifies the display name on the platform and cannot be the same as any other clusters.
KubeConfig: The KubeConfig file of the host cluster.
Click the “OK” button to import the cluster and node into the platform. Click the provider name (kubeadm-demo) to enter the Provider detail page, where you can view the cluster under the provider and perform the following operations on the provider:
Synchronization: Kubeclipper synchronizes cluster information every four hours. You can also click “Synchronize” to manually perform the operation. Edit: Edit the provider’s name, description, access information, and node connection method. Remove: Detach platform management while preserving Kubernetes itself. Cleanup also removes imported kc-agent installations and platform-created ServiceAccount, ClusterRoleBinding, and kubectl terminal resources. Previously managed nodes follow separate preservation rules. Check node ownership and retain kubeconfig before removal. Managed cluster management You can choose “Cluster Management” > “Cluster” to go to the cluster list page and view the list of all clusters, including hosted clusters and local clusters. Offline installation needs a platform deployment package and component resources for Kubernetes, the CRI, and the CNI. Registry resources describe image repositories; they do not replace offline packages.
Check resources After deploying the platform, log in and inspect resources and nodes:
kcctl resource list kcctl get node Match package architecture to the target nodes. The 1.7 matrix uses Kubernetes v1.37.0 / v1.36.4 / v1.35.8, containerd 2.2.4, and Calico v3.31.5. See offline component packages when more resources are needed.
Create the cluster kcctl create cluster defaults to offline installation. This example uses one test node:
kcctl create cluster --name offline-demo --master 192.168.10.21 --untaint-master \ --k8s-version v1.37.0 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 kcctl operation list -c offline-demo kcctl get cluster offline-demo -o yaml In the Console wizard, select prepared component versions, target nodes, and offline installation. Populate any image repository and configure its Registry resource first. Select storage plugins according to actual requirements; a particular NFS plugin is not a mandatory cluster-creation step.
Confirm installation Use Operations and node logs to locate failures. After obtaining kubeconfig, check Ready nodes, system Pods, and API readiness. Resolve missing resources, architecture mismatches, and unreachable image paths before retrying. See operations and logs.

body:
KubeClipper 1.7 executes cluster lifecycle work through Operation v2. Inspect the cluster object, then confirm outcomes using operation details and actual nodes.
kcctl get cluster kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml kcctl operation list -c demo Logs, retries, and cancellation See operations and logs for commands. Resolve the cause of a failure before retrying. Resetting cluster state does not repair nodes or undo completed work.
Access a cluster Obtain kubeconfig from the Console cluster details page, set KUBECONFIG, and run:
kubectl get nodes -o wide kubectl get pods -A kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose' Healthy platform status does not establish the health of every managed cluster. After upgrades, scaling, backup, or recovery, inspect the relevant nodes, system Pods, and application data.
Scaling and registries Use kcctl join to register new machines with the platform. Confirm that nodes are Ready and in the cluster’s region before adding them from the cluster details page. Evacuate workloads and check remaining capacity before removing cluster nodes. Platform kcctl drain removes an Agent; it is a separate operation from shrinking a cluster. See node management.
Configure Kubernetes image repositories and containerd pull registries separately. See registries and verify actual image pulls after changes.
Backup and restore Configure a backup space and associate it with the cluster through the edit action. For directory backup spaces, create and mount the agreed path on the relevant nodes and confirm write access. Start a backup, or configure a scheduled backup with its execution time and retention count. Confirm successful backup status and readable files. Select a backup belonging to the cluster for restoration. Follow its Operation, then check the API, nodes, system Pods, and application state. Cluster backups center on Kubernetes etcd snapshots. They do not include application files in persistent volumes; back up those separately. Restoration changes cluster state. Rehearse in an isolated environment: the existence of a backup record alone does not establish recoverability.
Upgrade Kubernetes Kubernetes upgrades are separate from KubeClipper platform upgrades. Back up the cluster, validate restoration, and check target component resources, images, and workload compatibility before selecting a target in the cluster upgrade action. This action is unavailable for hosted kubeadm clusters.
Inspect the CLI parameters with:
kcctl cluster upgrade --help Use --cluster-name and --version to select the cluster and target. Offline mode is the default; --online selects online mode and --image-registry selects a configured Registry resource. The target must exist in platform resources. The support matrix does not guarantee successful upgrades between every listed version. Follow the resulting Operation and repeat the cluster health checks above.
Delete a cluster Back up workloads and data before deletion, then follow the Operation:
kcctl delete cluster demo kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster Confirm deletion has finished before reusing nodes. Preserve errors and node state for diagnostics; forced deletion does not establish that cleanup completed.

The full 1.7.0 deployment package installs the platform. Additional Kubernetes, CRI, and CNI packages provide cluster resources. Deploy the platform using Getting started first.
Choose versions and architecture Use the 1.7 matrix. This Bash example prepares Kubernetes v1.37.0 for amd64. Prepare arm64 packages for arm64 nodes.
set -e ARCH=amd64 VERSION=v1.37.0 PKG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" COMPONENT_DIR="k8s/${VERSION}/${ARCH}" mkdir -p "${PKG_DIR}/${COMPONENT_DIR}" for FILE in manifest.json configs.tar.gz images.tar.gz; do curl -fL -o "${PKG_DIR}/${COMPONENT_DIR}/${FILE}" \ "https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/packages/${COMPONENT_DIR}/${FILE}" done tar -czf "k8s-${VERSION}-${ARCH}.tar.gz" -C "$PKG_DIR" k8s tar -tzf "k8s-${VERSION}-${ARCH}.tar.gz" Preserve the k8s/version/architecture/ hierarchy. Keep certificate and HTTP verification enabled. The download directory remains at $PKG_DIR for inspection and subsequent cleanup.
Other components use the same hierarchy. Archive the component directory with the following files:
Directory Version Required files Upload type k8s v1.37.0 manifest.json, configs.tar.gz, images.tar.gz k8s containerd 2.2.4 manifest.json, configs.tar.gz cri calico v3.31.5 manifest.json, images.tar.gz, charts.tgz cni For example, Calico uses packages/calico/v3.31.5/amd64/manifest.json. Packaging existing resources does not imply support for arbitrary custom versions.
Upload in the offline environment Transfer the archive to a deployment machine that can reach the platform and has the deployment configuration and Server SSH credentials.
kcctl resource push --pkg k8s-v1.37.0-amd64.tar.gz --type k8s kcctl resource list Use --type cri for containerd and --type cni for Calico. Confirm the versions and architecture in the resource list before creating an offline cluster. See Registry configuration for image registry settings.

KubeClipper 1.7 的集群生命周期操作由 Operation v2 执行。先查看集群对象，再用操作详情和节点实际状态确认结果。
kcctl get cluster kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml kcctl operation list -c demo 日志、重试和取消 完整命令见操作与日志。失败后先处理根因再重试；重置集群状态不会修复失败的节点或撤销已执行操作。
访问集群 在 Console 的集群详情页获取 kubeconfig，设置 KUBECONFIG 后执行：
kubectl get nodes -o wide kubectl get pods -A kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose' 平台状态正常不代表所有受管集群都正常。升级、扩缩容、备份和恢复后，都要检查对应集群中的节点、系统 Pod 和业务数据。
扩缩容与镜像仓库 先用 kcctl join 将新增机器纳入平台，确认节点就绪、区域与目标集群一致，再在集群详情中添加节点。移除节点前迁移工作负载并检查容量；平台的 kcctl drain 用于移除平台 Agent，不等同于集群缩容。节点接入步骤见节点管理。
Kubernetes 镜像仓库与 containerd 拉取仓库分别配置，具体步骤见镜像仓库。变更后检查实际镜像拉取结果。
备份与恢复 配置备份空间，并在编辑集群时关联该备份空间。使用目录备份空间时，先在相关节点创建并挂载约定路径，确认可写。 在集群中发起备份，或通过定时备份设置执行时间和保留数量；确认备份记录成功且文件可读取。 恢复时选择该集群的备份记录，跟踪恢复 Operation，完成后检查 API、节点、系统 Pod 和业务状态。 这里的集群备份以 Kubernetes etcd 快照为核心，不包含业务持久卷中的文件；应用数据需要另行备份。恢复会改变集群状态，先在隔离环境演练，不能仅凭备份记录存在判断可恢复。
Kubernetes 版本升级 这与 KubeClipper 平台升级是两项操作。先备份并验证恢复方案，检查目标版本的组件资源、镜像和工作负载兼容性，再从集群的升级入口选择目标版本。托管的 kubeadm 集群不提供此升级入口。
CLI 参数可用下列命令查看：
kcctl cluster upgrade --help 升级命令使用 --cluster-name 和 --version 指定集群与目标版本，默认采用离线方式；--online 改为在线方式，--image-registry 选择已配置的 Registry 资源。目标版本必须在平台可用资源中，不能将支持矩阵当作任意版本间升级成功的保证。提交后跟踪 Operation，并执行上面的集群健康检查。
删除集群 先确认工作负载和数据已备份，再发起删除并跟踪 Operation：
kcctl delete cluster demo kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster 确认删除结束后再复用节点。失败时保留日志和节点状态，参考平台诊断，不要用强制删除掩盖未完成的清理。

1.7.0 的完整部署包和额外的 Kubernetes / CRI / CNI 组件包用途不同。先使用快速开始中的完整部署包部署平台，再按实际需求补充组件资源。
选择版本和架构 以 1.7 版本说明中的矩阵为准。以下示例下载 Kubernetes v1.37.0 的 amd64 组件；arm64 节点需准备 arm64 包，不要混用架构。
在联网机器下载并打包 以下命令在 Bash 中执行，使用项目 OSS 原生域名。curl -fL 会在下载失败时退出；不要忽略证书或 HTTP 错误后继续打包。
set -e ARCH=amd64 VERSION=v1.37.0 PKG_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" COMPONENT_DIR="k8s/${VERSION}/${ARCH}" mkdir -p "${PKG_DIR}/${COMPONENT_DIR}" for FILE in manifest.json configs.tar.gz images.tar.gz; do curl -fL -o "${PKG_DIR}/${COMPONENT_DIR}/${FILE}" \ "https://kubeclipper.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/packages/${COMPONENT_DIR}/${FILE}" done tar -czf "k8s-${VERSION}-${ARCH}.tar.gz" -C "$PKG_DIR" k8s tar -tzf "k8s-${VERSION}-${ARCH}.tar.gz" 归档中需保留 k8s/版本/架构/ 层级，不能只压缩文件本身。下载目录保留在 $PKG_DIR，核对后可自行清理。
其他组件使用相同层级，按下表准备文件，再压缩对应组件目录：
组件目录 版本 必需文件 上传类型 k8s v1.37.0 manifest.json、configs.tar.gz、images.tar.gz k8s containerd 2.2.4 manifest.json、configs.tar.gz cri calico v3.31.5 manifest.json、images.tar.gz、charts.tgz cni 例如 Calico 路径为 packages/calico/v3.31.5/amd64/manifest.json。这些是已有组件资源的打包方式，不代表任意自定义版本都已被平台支持。
传入离线环境并上传 把归档传到能访问平台的部署机。该机器需保留部署配置和可登录 Server 的 SSH 凭据。
kcctl resource push --pkg k8s-v1.37.0-amd64.tar.gz --type k8s kcctl resource list 上传 containerd 和 Calico 时分别使用 --type cri、--type cni。确认平台能列出匹配的版本和架构，再按离线创建集群验证。镜像仓库的配置参见 Registry。

body:
Region management KubeClipper supports multi-region management. That is, all nodes and clusters managed by the platform are divided into physical or logical regions. On the Region Management page, you can view all regions in the platform. Click a region name to enter the region detail page, and you can view the clusters and nodes in the region.
Node management The platform supports multi-region management, that is, the owning region of all nodes managed by the platform. On the Region Management page, you can view all regions managed by the platform. Click a region name to go to the region details page, where you can view the list of all clusters and nodes in the region.
On the “Node Info” page, you can view the list of all nodes managed in the platform, node specifications, status and other information. Click the node name to enter the node detail page, you can view detailed node basic information and system information.
The node status in KubeClipper represents the management status of the node by kc-agent. Under normal circumstances, the node status is displayed as “Ready”. The default monitoring grace period is 4 minutes, checked every 10 seconds. After the grace period, the status changes to “Unknown”; scheduling or communication delays can affect when the change becomes visible. Investigate the Agent, network, and Server connectivity before scheduling new cluster installation or expansion on an unknown node.
Add node When deploying KubeClipper, you can add the initial server nodes which are used to deploy KubeClipper's own services, and agent nodes which are used to deploy kubernetes clusters. In a KubeClipper environment for experimentation or development, you can add a server node as an agent node at the same time. However, if it is used for a production environment, it is recommended not to reuse the server node as an agent node.
You can also use the kcctl join command to add agent nodes to KubeClipper, and mark a region for each agent node. The region can be a physical or logical location. You can use nodes in the same region to create a kubernetes cluster, but cannot use nodes across regions to create a cluster. Nodes in unmarked regions belong to the default region.
Command line example:
kcctl join --agent beijing:1.2.3.4 --agent shanghai:2.3.4.5 Remove node When you no longer need some nodes, you can use the kcctl drain command to remove nodes from the platform.
Command line example:
kcctl drain --agent 192.168.10.19 Connect Terminal On the node list page, you can click the “Connect Terminal” button on the right side of the target node, enter the node port and username password information in the pop-up window, access the node SSH console and execute command tasks.
Enable/disable a node You can click the Disable button on the right side of the node to temporarily disable the node. The node in the disabled state cannot be created or added to the cluster.

区域管理 平台支持多区域管理，即为平台管理的所有节点和集群进行物理或逻辑的区域划分。您可以在“区域管理”页面查看平台内管理的所有区域，点击区域名称，进入区域详情页面，可以查看区域下的所有集群列表和节点列表。
节点管理 您可以在“节点信息”页面查看平台中管理的全部节点列表，和节点规格、状态等信息。点击节点名称进入节点详情页面，可以查看详细的节点基本信息和系统信息。
KubeClipper 中的节点状态表示 kc-agent 对节点的管理状态。正常情况下，节点状态显示为“就绪”，默认节点健康监控宽限期为 4 分钟，每 10 秒检查一次；超过宽限期后，状态会更新为“未知”，实际显示时间还会受到调度和通信延迟影响。此时先排查 Agent、网络和 Server 连通性，恢复就绪后再安排新的集群部署或扩容。
添加节点 在部署 KubeClipper 时，您就可以添加初始的 server 节点和 agent 节点，其中，server 节点用于部署 KubeClipper 自身服务，agent 节点可用于部署 kubernetes 集群。在用于实验或开发的 KubeClipper 环境，您可以将 server 节点同时添加为 agent 节点。但如果用于生产环境，建议不要将 server 节点复用为 agent 节点。
您也可以使用 kcctl join 命令为 KubeClipper 添加 agent 节点。同时，您可以为每个 agent 节点标记一个区域，区域可以是物理的或逻辑的位置，您可以使用同一区域的节点创建 kubernetes 集群，但不可以使用跨区域的节点创建集群。未标记区域的节点默认属于 default 区域。
命令行示例：
kcctl join --agent beijing:1.2.3.4 --agent shanghai:2.3.4.5 移除节点 当您不再需要某些节点，可以使用 kcctl drain 命令将节点从平台中移除。
命令行示例：
kcctl drain --agent 192.168.10.19 连接终端 在节点列表页面，您可以点击目标节点右侧的“连接终端”按钮，在连接终端的弹窗中输入节点端口和用户名密码信息后，访问节点 SSH 控制台并执行命令。
启用/禁用节点 您可以点击节点右侧“禁用”按钮暂时禁用节点，禁用状态下的节点不允许创建或添加到集群。

body:
Create user After installing KubeClipper, you need to create a user of a desired role. Initially, there is only one user, admin, by default, with the platform administrator role.
Click “Access Control” > “Users” to enter the user management page, click the “Create User” button in the upper left corner, fill in the user name, password, alias name and other information in the pop-up window, specify the user role, and click the “OK” button. The four initial roles in the system are as follows:
platform-admin: Platform administrator, with the authority to set platform, cluster management, user management, audit, etc.
cluster-manager: Cluster administrator, with all cluster management permissions.
iam-manager: User administrator, with all user management permissions.
platform-view: Platform read-only user, with all platform viewing permissions.
After the user is created, you can view the user details and login logs on the user detail page and perform the following operations:
Edit: Edit user alias, role, mobile phone number, email information.
Edit Password: Edit the user login password.
Delete: Delete the user.
Create a custom role In addition to system initial roles, you can also create customized roles to meet business needs.
Click “Access Control” > “Roles” to enter the role management page. You can click the “Create Role” button in the upper left corner to create a custom role.
On the Create Role page, you need to fill in the role name and description, and check the permissions required. Some permissions depend on other permissions. When these permissions are selected, the dependent permissions will be automatically selected.
After creating a customized role, you can view the basic role information, role permission list, authorized user list on the role detail page, and perform the following operations:
Edit: Edit the custom role description.
Edit permissions: Edit permissions of the customized role.
Delete: To delete a customized role, make sure that no user is using the role to be deleted.
Access to external users External users can log in to KubeClipper via the OIDC protocol .
First, the platform administrator needs to log in to the platform server node and insert the following information under “authentication” in the kubeclipper-server.yaml file:
oauthOptions: identityProviders: - name: keycloak type: OIDC mappingMethod: auto provider: clientID: kc clientSecret: REPLACE_WITH_CLIENT_SECRET issuer: https://idp.example.com/realms/kubeclipper scopes: - openid - email redirectURL: https://console.example.com/oauth2/redirect/keycloak Merge this fragment under authentication in the existing configuration. Replace the example domains and REPLACE_WITH_CLIENT_SECRET. Register exactly the same redirectURL with the IdP; its final path component must match the provider name. Update each Server and restart kc-server one node at a time.
Under “provider”, you need to fill in the clientID , clientSecret , and issuer information of your OAuth2 service, taking keycloak as an example, as shown in the figure below.
RedirectURL example: https://console.example.com/oauth2/redirect/keycloak
OAuth2 users can log in to the KubeClipper platform by following these steps:
Click the “OAuth2 Login” button on the login page, enter the OAuth2 login page, fill in the username and password to enter the KubeClipper platform. When logging in for the first time, you will not be able to access the platform because you have not been granted any permission.
The platform administrator or other user with user management rights log in to KubeClipper, find the target OAuth2 user on the user management page, and set the user role by editing the user information.
The OAuth2 user repeats the first step, logs in to KubeClipper, and accesses the platform normally.

body:
用户管理 安装 KubeClipper 之后，您需要创建所需角色的用户。一开始，系统默认只有一个用户 admin，具有平台管理员角色。
点击“访问控制”>“用户”，进入用户管理页面，点击左上角“创建用户”按钮，在弹窗中填写用户名、密码、手机号码、邮箱等信息，并指定用户角色，点击“确认”按钮。系统内置四个角色如下：
平台管理员：拥有集群管理、用户管理、审计管理等全部平台查看和操作权限。
集群管理员：拥有所有集群管理权限。
用户管理员：拥有所有用户管理权限。
平台只读用户：拥有全部平台查看权限。
用户创建完成后，您可以在用户详情页面查看用户详情信息，并执行以下操作：
编辑：编辑用户别名、角色、手机号、邮箱信息。
编辑密码：编辑用户登录密码。
删除：删除用户。
在用户详情页面，您还可以查看当前用户的登录日志列表。
您可以编辑平台 /etc/kubeclipper-server/kubeclipper-server.yaml 文件，根据需要设置用户登录日志的最大保留条数和保留期限，清理逻辑仅在该用户的日志总数超过最大条数时触发：先删除超额的旧记录，再清理剩余的过期记录；未超过最大条数时，不会仅因过期而删除。
自定义角色 除了系统内置角色，您也可以创建自定义角色，以满足业务需要。
点击“访问控制”>“角色”，进入角色管理页面，您可以点击左上角“创建角色”按钮，创建自定义角色。
在创建角色页面，您需要填写角色名称和描述，并勾选自定义角色所需权限，一些权限依赖于其他权限，在选择这些权限时，将自动选中依赖的权限。
创建自定义角色完成后，您可以在角色详情页面查看角色基本信息、角色权限列表、授权用户列表，并对自定义角色执行以下操作：
编辑：编辑自定义角色描述。
编辑权限：编辑自定义角色下的权限。
删除：删除自定义角色，需确保没有用户使用待删除角色。
接入外部用户 KubeClipper 可以通过 OIDC 协议使用外部用户登录。
首先，平台管理员需要登录平台 server 节点，在 kubeclipper-server.yaml 文件中的 authentication 下插入以下信息：
oauthOptions: identityProviders: - name: keycloak type: OIDC mappingMethod: auto provider: clientID: kc clientSecret: REPLACE_WITH_CLIENT_SECRET issuer: https://idp.example.com/realms/kubeclipper scopes: - openid - email redirectURL: https://console.example.com/oauth2/redirect/keycloak 这是 authentication 下的配置片段，需合并到现有配置。将示例域名和 REPLACE_WITH_CLIENT_SECRET 替换为实际值；IdP 注册的回调地址必须与 redirectURL 完全一致，路径末尾的 keycloak 与提供商 name 一致。各 Server 更新配置后，按节点滚动重启 kc-server。
其中，“provider” 下需要您填写自己的 OAuth2 服务的clientID、clientSecret、issuer信息，以 keycloak 为例，如下图所示。
redirectURL示例：https://console.example.com/oauth2/redirect/keycloak
OAuth2 用户可以通过以下步骤访问和使用 KubeClipper 平台：
点击登录页的 “OAuth2 登录”按钮，进入 OAuth2 登录页面，输入用户名密码登录，进入 KubeClipper 平台，首次登录，您会因未被授予权限而无法访问平台。 平台管理员或其他拥有用户管理权限的用户登录 KubeClipper，在用户管理页面，找到目标 OAuth2 用户，通过编辑用户指定用户角色。 OAuth2 用户重复第一步，登录 KubeClipper，就可以正常访问平台并执行角色权限内操作。

body:
KubeClipper 1.7 represents installation, upgrades, backup, and deletion as Operations, with Tasks assigned by step and node. A successful submission means the request was accepted; query its result afterward.
Find an operation kcctl operation list kcctl operation list -c demo Copy an actual operation ID from the list, then inspect details and logs:
OPERATION_ID='<actual operation ID>' kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow Use logs to identify the failed step and node. In an interactive terminal, open the cluster’s TUI log viewer:
kcctl operation logs --cluster demo Use the operation-ID commands for plain-text logs in scripts and non-interactive terminals.
Handle a failure Preserve operation details, failed-node logs, and cluster state. Resolve the missing package, image download, node connectivity, or service problem before retrying:
kcctl operation retry "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow Check actual cluster and node state after the retry. Its command return value alone does not establish recovery. If parameters are wrong, review the task configuration rather than retrying repeatedly.
Cancel work kcctl operation cancel "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" Cancellation does not roll back installation or data changes that have already happened. Confirm tasks have stopped and inspect existing changes on the nodes before cleanup.
Confirm the result Check the Operation result, kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml, Kubernetes nodes, and system Pods together. After cluster deletion, check the platform list and node residue. See platform diagnostics for platform-level issues.

KubeClipper 1.7 将安装、升级、备份、删除等工作建模为 Operation，并按步骤和节点执行 Task。提交命令成功只表示请求已被接受，最终结果需要继续查询。
查找操作 kcctl operation list kcctl operation list -c demo 从列表复制实际操作 ID 后查看详情和日志：
OPERATION_ID='<实际操作 ID>' kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow 通过日志定位失败步骤和节点。在交互式终端中，可按集群打开 TUI 日志视图：
kcctl operation logs --cluster demo 脚本和非交互终端使用带操作 ID 的纯文本日志命令。
处理失败 先保留操作详情、失败节点日志和集群状态，处理包缺失、镜像下载、节点网络或服务异常等原因，再重试：
kcctl operation retry "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation logs "$OPERATION_ID" --follow 重试后再次检查实际集群和节点，不能只看 retry 命令返回值。若参数本身错误，先核对任务配置，不要用反复重试代替修正。
取消操作 kcctl operation cancel "$OPERATION_ID" kcctl operation describe "$OPERATION_ID" 取消不等于回滚已经执行的安装或数据操作。继续确认任务是否停止，以及节点上已经产生的变更；清理前先确定资源归属。
确认成功 结合 Operation 结果、kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml、Kubernetes 节点与 Pod 状态确认结果。集群删除后还要检查平台列表和节点残留。平台问题参考诊断指南。

body:
Locate the failing layer first: the platform, Agent, resource downloads, or the Kubernetes cluster.
Symptom Start with Console does not open or API connection fails Platform health; check the console and API addresses and ports Agent or node is not ready Node services; inspect service logs and connectivity Deployment precheck or resource download fails Deployment failures; follow the reported node and check Cluster creation task fails Cluster task failures; locate the Operation and failing step Platform health kcctl version kcctl status kcctl status -o json kcctl doctor status summarizes kc-server, kc-etcd, and kc-agent health. doctor checks local access, services, platform etcd, and Agents, with evidence for failed checks. Unhealthy results return a nonzero exit code for scripting. Neither command repairs the environment.
If the API cannot be reached, check that kcctl login points to the HTTPS API endpoint, normally port 8080. Inspect local login and deployment configuration and SSH connectivity from the deployment host.
Node services Run on the relevant Linux node:
sudo systemctl status kc-server kc-etcd kc-agent --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-server -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-agent -n 100 --no-pager An Agent-only node is not expected to run a Server or platform etcd. Interpret service results according to node roles. Check disk space, clock synchronization, management addresses, and firewall rules.
Deployment failures Precheck errors identify the check and node. If services already exist, establish whether they belong to an active platform before changing anything. For download failures, verify the URL, certificate, file size, and archive contents. Do not hide certificate failures by disabling verification.
Cluster task failures kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml kcctl get node kcctl resource list Use operations and logs to locate the failing step and node. Check package versions and architectures for offline installation. For image pull failures, check the registry address, credentials, and connectivity. 先确定故障发生在平台、Agent、资源下载还是 Kubernetes 集群，再针对对应层排查。
现象 先检查 控制台打不开或 API 连接失败 平台状态，确认控制台与 API 使用了正确地址和端口 Agent 或节点未就绪 节点服务，检查对应节点的服务日志和连通性 安装预检查失败或资源包下载失败 部署失败，按报错中的节点和检查项处理 创建集群的任务失败 集群任务失败，先找到 Operation 和失败步骤 平台状态 kcctl version kcctl status kcctl status -o json kcctl doctor status 汇总 kc-server、kc-etcd 和 kc-agent 的健康状态。doctor 检查本地访问、服务、平台 etcd 和 Agent，并输出失败证据。非健康结果会返回非零退出码，适合用于检查脚本；两个命令都不会自动修复环境。
若平台 API 无法访问，检查 kcctl login 使用的地址是否为 HTTPS API 入口，默认端口 8080。检查本地登录和部署配置，以及部署机到各节点的 SSH 连通性。
节点服务 在对应的 Linux 节点执行：
sudo systemctl status kc-server kc-etcd kc-agent --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-server -n 100 --no-pager sudo journalctl -u kc-agent -n 100 --no-pager 只部署 Agent 的节点不应要求存在 Server 或平台 etcd 服务。结合实际节点角色解读结果，并检查磁盘、时间同步、管理地址和防火墙。
部署失败 预检查错误会指出检查项和节点。若服务已存在，先确认该节点是否属于正在使用的平台；不要删除服务来绕过检查。下载错误应核对地址、证书、文件大小和包内容，不能用关闭证书校验掩盖错误。
集群任务失败 kcctl operation list -c demo kcctl get cluster demo -o yaml kcctl get node kcctl resource list 通过操作与日志定位具体步骤和节点。离线安装核对版本、架构和资源包；镜像拉取失败核对镜像仓库地址、认证和网络。提交 Issue 时提供版本、拓扑、脱敏后的错误和操作 ID，移除密码、token、私钥与 kubeconfig 凭据。

A Registry resource describes a Kubernetes image source or adds image-pull configuration to containerd. It is separate from platform offline resource packages. Creating a Registry does not copy images into it.
Create a Registry The following example describes an HTTP registry on a management network. Configure HTTPS, CA trust, and authentication for your actual registry; consult command help for all flags.
kcctl create registry --name internal --host registry.example.com:5000 --scheme http kcctl get registry kcctl create registry -h Authentication uses --auth-username and --auth-password; protect credentials from shell history and terminal logs. For HTTPS, review --ca and --skip-tls-verify instead of reusing the HTTP example unchanged.
Select a registry for a cluster kcctl create cluster --name demo --master 192.168.10.21 \ --k8s-version v1.37.0 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 \ --image-registry internal --cri-registry internal --image-registry selects a Registry resource for Kubernetes images. --cri-registry adds Registry configuration to containerd; select multiple resources as needed. Without an explicit image registry, components use their own defaults and applicable Agent image-mirror settings. Kubernetes and Calico do not necessarily use the same default repository. Populate the registry with the required images first. Check actual image paths, authentication, certificates, and connectivity from cluster nodes. Offline installation also needs the resource packages.

创建 Registry 资源 以下是管理网络中 HTTP 镜像仓库的例子。生产仓库应按实际情况配置 HTTPS、CA 和认证；完整参数见命令帮助。
kcctl create registry --name internal --host registry.example.com:5000 --scheme http kcctl get registry kcctl create registry -h 需要认证时可通过 --auth-username 和 --auth-password 配置，注意命令历史和终端日志中的凭据暴露。使用 HTTPS 时核对 --ca 与 --skip-tls-verify，不要直接沿用 HTTP 示例配置。
为集群选择仓库 kcctl create cluster --name demo --master 192.168.10.21 \ --k8s-version v1.37.0 --cri containerd --cri-version 2.2.4 \ --cni calico --cni-version v3.31.5 \ --image-registry internal --cri-registry internal --image-registry 选择用于 Kubernetes 镜像的 Registry 资源。 --cri-registry 将 Registry 资源的配置加入 containerd；可按需要指定多个资源。 未指定镜像仓库时，各组件采用各自的默认值和适用的 Agent 镜像源配置。不要假定 Kubernetes、Calico 等组件都从同一个默认仓库拉取。 创建前把所需镜像放入仓库，并检查集群节点实际可访问的镜像路径、认证和证书。离线安装还要满足资源包要求。
